title: Circuit-to-three-CNF encoding
statement: An encoded Boolean circuit is a pair consisting of a natural number $n$ and a Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs. The circuit-to-three-CNF map sends this pair to the encoded exactly-three CNF formula obtained by padding the circuit's width-three CNF; the resulting formula has $n$ plus the circuit's gate count plus three variables.
hypotheses_covered: An encoded Boolean circuit, consisting of $n$ and a circuit on $n$ inputs
caveat: The supplied definitions do not describe the padding construction, so its precise clause-level effect cannot be rendered from this payload.
